busy_recording: Stop recording before running a chain.
empty: No chains yet. Record one, or import AegisubChain’s.
import_asked_button: step %1 asked for its button, so it presses the recorded one
import_hint: An imported chain shows each of its dialogs once, filled in, the first time it runs, so it learns them. After that it runs as recorded. A button set to “Set in dialog” becomes a constant.
import_missing: no loaded macro “%1”: kept, it won’t run until the script is loaded
learns: imported, shows its dialogs on the first run
name: Name
needs_hikarisub: Macro chains needs a newer HikariSub, one whose plugins can group their steps into one undo step. Update HikariSub to record and run chains.
nothing_recorded: Nothing was recorded, so no chain was saved.
recording_hint: Run macros and commands as usual. Each one that applies becomes a step; Undo takes the last one back.
show_dialogs: Show this step’s dialogs, filled in
slot_empty: No chain is in slot %1. Choose one in a chain’s editor.
undo_hint: The %1 steps that ran are one undo step.
undo_hint_one: The step that ran is one undo step.
undo_moved: The subtitles changed after the chain, so undo it with Edit › Undo.
unreadable: chains.json couldn’t be read, so it was kept as chains.unreadable.json and the list starts empty.
